title: VanillaPvP
description: A vanilla based PvP pack to keep the vanilla feel as well as that PvP style!
body:
This pack aims to give a PvP style while still keeping that vanilla feel.  
keeping most of the textures the same except for certain assets related to PvP.  
Join the Discord link if you have any issues. suggestions, or find any bugs. -TwstedTard
